lines.zh: 跳跃前行，发出尖锐鸣声。
lines.en: Hop forward, sharp cry.
Chew leaves, crack sound.

lines.zh: 缓缓移动，头冠轻轻摆动。
lines.en: Slow move, head crest sways.
Peck ground, light sound.
Forage, occasional cry.

lines.zh: 咀嚼食物，发出轻微咀嚼声。
lines.en: Chew food, light munching.
Move leisurely, observe surroundings.
Lower head, crest touches ground.
Eyes sparkle while eating.
Lightly hop forward.

lines.zh: 短腿小跑，掀起一路尘土。
lines.en: My short legs trot up a trail of dust.

lines.zh: 我低着头，一路啃一路走。
lines.en: Head down, I nibble as I walk.

lines.zh: 头冠一晃一晃，踩着落叶。
lines.en: My crest bobs as I step through fallen leaves.

lines.zh: 小跑两步，回头看看同伴。
lines.en: I trot a few steps and look back for the herd.
Stand quietly, crest shines.
Lower head, occasional cry.
Bask in sun, head sways.
Body sways, crest glows.
Look up, light cry.
Shake head leisurely.
Lower head, occasionally peck.
Peck leaf, light sound.
Eat leaves quietly.

lines.zh: 头冠微微闪烁，享受片刻。
lines.en: Crest glows, brief respite.
I bask in the sun with my eyes half shut.
I tilt my head to the wind like a parrot.

lines.zh: 爪子刨出一个小坑，坐进去。
lines.en: I scoop a small hollow and settle into it.

lines.zh: 我把头冠在树干上蹭了蹭。
lines.en: I rub my crest against a trunk.
Head up, notice player.

lines.zh: 盯着玩家，发出轻微鸣声。
lines.en: Stare at player, light cry.

lines.zh: 靠近玩家，发出好奇叫声。
lines.en: Approach, curious cry.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，只想吃这丛蕨。
lines.en: Head tilted, I only want this fern.
Approach, light sound.
Look at player, light peck.
Touch player, crest light.
Peck player, light sound.
Approach, seek closeness.
Cry a few times, friendly.

lines.zh: 我扬起头冠，打量你的手。
lines.en: I raise my crest and size up your hands.
You crouch down, and I lean in to sniff.

lines.zh: 受伤的鹦鹉嘴龙发出微弱的叫声。
lines.en: The psittacosaurus lets out a weak cry.

lines.zh: 它挣扎着，发出痛苦的叫声。
lines.en: It struggles, making a painful sound.

lines.zh: 受伤的鹦鹉嘴龙显得十分虚弱。
lines.en: The psittacosaurus looks very weak.
Pain is in its cry.

lines.zh: 受伤的小鹦鹉嘴龙哀鸣着。
lines.en: The injured psittacus baby cries.
Its cries grow faint.

lines.zh: 受伤的鹦鹉嘴龙显得非常疲倦。
lines.en: The psittacosaurus looks very tired.
It lets out a painful screech.
The psittacosaurus falls silent.
It begins to wheeze, softly.

lines.zh: 贪食的鹦鹉嘴龙张开大嘴，露出尖锐牙齿。
lines.en: The psittacosaurus opens its mouth, showing sharp teeth.

lines.zh: 幼体鹦鹉嘴龙慢慢靠近树叶。
lines.en: A young psittacosaurus slowly approaches the leaves.

lines.zh: 鹦鹉嘴龙的头冠在阳光下闪闪发光。
lines.en: The psittacosaurus’s horn shines in the sunlight.

lines.zh: 鹦鹉嘴龙用舌头卷起一片叶子。
lines.en: The psittacosaurus licks up a leaf with its tongue.

lines.zh: 鹦鹉嘴龙咀嚼着一片草叶。
lines.en: The psittacosaurus chews on a grass leaf.

lines.zh: 它用尖牙咬住一根树枝。
lines.en: It bites a branch with its sharp teeth.

lines.zh: 鹦鹉嘴龙欢快地发出鸣叫声。
lines.en: The psittacosaurus makes a happy chirp.

lines.zh: 它用角触碰着同伴的头冠。
lines.en: It touches its companion’s horn with its head.

lines.zh: 鹦鹉嘴龙的眼睛盯着地上的树叶。
lines.en: The psittacosaurus’s eyes are on the leaves on the ground.

lines.zh: 它小心翼翼地走着，寻找食物。
lines.en: It walks carefully, searching for food.

lines.zh: 两只鹦鹉嘴龙碰撞，头冠碰撞发出响声。
lines.en: Two psittacosaurs collide, their horns clashing.

lines.zh: 鹦鹉嘴龙的头冠在碰撞中受损。
lines.en: The psittacosaurus’s horn is damaged in the collision.

lines.zh: 鹦鹉嘴龙试图用头冠抵住对手。
lines.en: The psittacosaurs try to push each other with their horns.

lines.zh: 鹦鹉嘴龙的头冠在空中发出闪光。
lines.en: The psittacosaurs’ horns flash in the air.

lines.zh: 它们用头冠顶撞，试图展示力量。
lines.en: They use their horns to bump, showing their strength.

lines.zh: 鹦鹉嘴龙在战斗中挥动着头冠。
lines.en: The psittacosaurs swing their horns in battle.

lines.zh: 一只鹦鹉嘴龙试图用头冠攻击另一只。
lines.en: One psittacosaurus tries to attack another with its horn.

lines.zh: 它们的头冠在空中交织。
lines.en: Their horns interlace in the air.

lines.zh: 鹦鹉嘴龙的头冠在激烈碰撞后破裂。
lines.en: The psittacosaurs’ horns break in the collision.

lines.zh: 它们激烈地互相顶撞，头冠闪闪发光。
lines.en: They bump each other fiercely, their horns flashing.

lines.zh: 成年鹦鹉嘴龙用头冠触碰伴侣。
lines.en: An adult psittacosaurus touches its mate with its horn.

lines.zh: 鹦鹉嘴龙用头冠展示爱意。
lines.en: The psittacosaurs show affection with their horns.

lines.zh: 它们互相用头冠轻轻触碰。
lines.en: They gently touch each other with their horns.

lines.zh: 鹦鹉嘴龙的头冠在空中交织。
lines.en: Their horns interlace in the air.

lines.zh: 它们用头冠轻轻碰撞，表达爱意。
lines.en: They lightly bump heads with affection.

lines.zh: 鹦鹉嘴龙的头冠在空中轻轻触碰。
lines.en: Their horns gently touch in the air.

lines.zh: 它们互相用头冠表达亲密。
lines.en: They express closeness with their horns.

lines.zh: 鹦鹉嘴龙的头冠在空中形成心形。
lines.en: Their horns form a heart in the air.

lines.zh: 它们互相用头冠轻轻触碰，充满爱意。
lines.en: They gently touch each other with their horns, full of love.

lines.zh: 成年鹦鹉嘴龙用头冠表达爱意。
lines.en: The adult psittacosaurs express love with their horns.
Eat some leaves!
Such a tasty leaf!

lines.zh: 我叼起它，跑回自己的窝。
lines.en: I take it in my beak and run to my nest.
This tender shoot: I drag it along with me.
Hey, kid, taste this!
I need more leaves!
Don’t get near my nest!
This is my home!
Feel my sharp beak!
This is my food!
Prey acquired!
Don't poke a Cretaceous ceratopsian.
Time to feed!

lines.zh: 我雄性的头冠，颜色亮一点。
lines.en: As a male, my crest runs brighter.

lines.zh: 我这只小角龙，先盯上你了。
lines.en: This little ceratopsian has eyes on you first.
Expect the attack!
You’ll regret it!
Stay away from my eggs or I bite.
Prepare to be hit!
I’m the predator!

lines.zh: 你踩进我的窝，我盯住了你。
lines.en: You stepped in my nest, and now I am watching.
I put the young behind me.
I lower my head and aim my beak.

lines.zh: 鼻子一哼，我决定赶你走。
lines.en: A snort, and I decide to drive you off.

lines.zh: 我歪头看你，鹦鹉嘴张开。
lines.en: I tilt my head and open my parrot beak.
Be careful!
Here I come, no run!
The male's crest is brighter, and I have my eye on you.

lines.zh: 鹦鹉嘴咬得住嫩枝，也咬得住你。
lines.en: These parrot jaws bite ferns. They will bite you too.
I’m using my beak!
I do not eat meat, but I will butt you.

lines.zh: 小角龙冲起来，也很有劲。
lines.en: Even a small ceratopsian hits hard when it charges.
Beware my attack!
I won’t let go!

lines.zh: 我前脚刨地，准备冲一下。
lines.en: I paw the ground, ready for a charge.
I crouch with my crest aimed forward.
My beak is open and ready to peck.
One more step and I come at you.

lines.zh: 我挡在树丛前面，不让路。
lines.en: I block the brush and will not move.
My parrot beak is made for tender leaves.
Peck you!
Feel my teeth!
Dinosaur attack!
Eat leaves!
Butt you good!
See my beak!
Dinosaur pride!
My horn is sharp!
My beak is made for tender leaves.

lines.zh: 我用短角顶了一下你的膝盖。
lines.en: I jab my short horn into your knee.

lines.zh: 喙啄下去，咬住你的裤脚。
lines.en: My beak snaps down and catches your trouser leg.
I swing my crest with a dull thud.

lines.zh: 撞完这一下，我退回去守窝。
lines.en: After the hit I back off to guard the nest.
Feeding time!

lines.zh: 我从巢里出来，踩着暖土。
lines.en: I step out of the nest onto warm soil.
Find fresh leaves!
Sky is my home!
Share lunch with friends!
Rest on the grass!
Find clear streams!
Morning’s messenger!
Find food in sunlight!

lines.zh: 蛋壳裂开，我湿漉漉地爬出来。
lines.en: The shell cracks and I crawl out, still wet.
I poke my head out of the incubator.

lines.zh: 白垩纪的风把我吹醒了。
lines.en: A Cretaceous wind wakes me.

lines.zh: 我踩着一地蕨叶走出来。
lines.en: I walk out over a floor of ferns.

lines.zh: 小角龙出生了，只有五点血。
lines.en: A little ceratopsian is born with only five health.

lines.zh: 孵化完成，我抖掉身上的碎壳。
lines.en: Hatching done, I shake off the shell bits.
The sun is out, and I break free of the egg.

lines.zh: 我竖起头冠，第一次站起来。
lines.en: I raise my crest and stand for the first time.

lines.zh: 二十五点血的我，站在草丛里。
lines.en: With twenty-five health I stand in the grass.
The flames burn its skin.
It fell from a height and is injured.

lines.zh: 水淹没了它的身体，它受伤了。
lines.en: The water drowned it and it's injured.
The explosion hit it.
A stone hit it.

lines.zh: 它的身体被魔法击中，受伤了。
lines.en: It's hit by magic and is injured.

lines.zh: 饥饿使它虚弱，它受伤了。
lines.en: Starvation weakens it, it's injured.
Lightning struck it.
It falls into the void.
